description: On the tabletop in front of you are a pink bowl and several small items, including a yellow rubber duck, two markers, a green block, a small yellow cube, and a pair of cherries. The right hand moves in from the right toward the duck, grasps it as a right-hand object, lifts it up and over the bowl, then lowers and releases it into the bowl while the left hand stays open and mostly still to the left without touching anything.
